About Us

TTC de la Salle Byumba · Smart Classroom & eLearning Portal

✕

🎓 Our Institution

TTC de la Salle Byumba is a Teacher Training College located in Byumba, Northern Province, Rwanda. Operated by the De La Salle Brothers, we are committed to excellence in teacher education, forming future educators equipped with knowledge, values, and 21st‑century skills.

2026

Our Mission

📖 Mission

To provide quality teacher education rooted in Catholic values, nurturing competent, reflective and ethical teachers who contribute to Rwanda's national development through the transformation of education.

🔬 Smart Classroom Initiative

This portal is the heart of our Smart Classroom Resource Manager — a digital ecosystem that integrates REB eLearning progress tracking, ICT lab management, library systems, and classroom equipment inventory into one unified platform, empowering teachers and administrators with real-time data.

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how the Smart Classroom Portal / TTC eLearning Monitor collects, uses, and protects user information.

Introduction

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard data when you use our website.

Information We Collect

  • Personal Data: Names, email addresses, or contact details submitted via forms.
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, videos viewed, and documents accessed.
  • Technical Data: Browser type, device information, and IP address.

How We Use Information

  • To provide access to educational materials (videos, documents, gallery).
  • To respond to inquiries submitted through the Contact Us form.
  • To improve site functionality and user experience.

Data Sharing

We do not sell or share personal data with third parties. Data may be shared only with authorized school administrators for educational purposes.

Security

We use secure protocols and antivirus-protected systems to safeguard data.

Children's Privacy

This site is intended for educational use. Children under 13 should use the site under teacher or parent supervision.

Changes to Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy. Updates will be posted on this page.

Terms of Use

These Terms of Use govern access and usage of the Smart Classroom Portal / TTC eLearning Monitor website.

Acceptance of Terms

By accessing this website, you agree to comply with these Terms of Use.

Permitted Use

  • Access and download educational materials for learning purposes.
  • Share resources within the school community.

Prohibited Use

  • Unauthorized copying, distribution, or modification of site content.
  • Uploading harmful files, malware, or offensive material.
  • Misuse of contact forms for spam or unrelated communication.

Intellectual Property

All videos, documents, and resources are property of the school unless otherwise stated.

Disclaimer

Content is provided for educational purposes only. We are not responsible for external links or third-party content.

Termination of Access

We reserve the right to restrict access if these terms are violated.
